tournament.name: Inaugural  DeathBallMPLS Showdown @ BauhausBrewLabs
tournament.description: Welcome any and all to our first ever DeathBall showdown at Bauhaus Brewlabs. The format is double elimination and comprised of "Best of 3" matches (with the exception of grand finals which will be played out as a best of 5). Map choice begins with the winner of a friendly game of "Rock Paper Scissors SHOOT" and then alternates between the two players until the round is over (until a winners and losers bracket is established in which the player from winners bracket will be allowed to choose first). Lets Ball!

tournament.name: SGDQ 2025 - DeathBall
tournament.description:
The Deathball tournament tournament will take place on Tuesday, July 8th at 2:30 local time. Please arrive 15 minutes early so that we have the time explain rules and procedures, and to check in to confirm your spot in the tournament. Due to our limited time, we are capping the tournament at 64 players. If we reach the cap, there will be a waitlist to ensure that as many players as possible can play.


Matches will be played in the following manner:

Most Matches: First to 1 victory wins

Top 4 Matches: First to 2 victories wins

Grand Finals: First to 3 victories wins

The tournament organizer retains the right to modify the specific win count for certain matches to ensure that our tournament finishes on time


Matches will be played on the default stage for the game.


We will be organizing players to ensure they are ready for their match about 5-10 minutes ahead of time. If you need to leave for any reason while you are still in the tournament, either temporarily or permanently, please notify the tournament organizer so that we canplan accordingly.

tournament.name: SGDQ 2026 - DeathBall
tournament.description:
DEATHBALL!!!


Tournament takes place at SGDQ in Minneapolis, Minnesota. You must be registered for SGDQ 2026 to participate in the tournament.


The tournament will take place on July 7th at 6pm local time. Participants are expected to check in with the tournament organizer no later than the start time to confirm their participation


The maximum number of participants for this tournament is 64. Registrations beyond this number will be placed on a waitlist.


FORMAT:


Double elimination

Bubble only

Players will be assigned to purple or green wizard based on their placement

Top players from the 2025 edition of the tournament will be manually seeded based on their results. All other players will be randomly seeded


Early stage matches (tentatively pre-Top 12)

Best of 1 game

Played on arena (default) map


Late stage (tentatively Top 12)

Best of 3 games

First game played on arena map

Subsequent games played on map chosen by player who lost in the previous game

Repeats allowed


Grand finals

Best of 5

First game on arena map 

Subsequent maps picked by previous loser

Repeats allowed


Exact format, player cap, and rules are subject to change based on cabinet and space availability, pace of play, and are subject to tournament organizer discretion

tournament.name: QuakeCon Arcade 2026: DeathBall 2v2
tournament.description:
Single elimination bracket, best of 3 (first to 2), matches played on default map only. We will do our best to pair up solo participants into teams! For filling out the registration please enter your team name or both of your handles in the same field.


Walk ups welcome at all arcade tournaments, please be near the machine at the start time to be added to the bracket!
